title: Spacious Home By Airport & Lake
description:
Our house is located in a quiet neighborhood across the street from the Percy Priest Lake and about 7 miles south of the Nashville International Airport. We are less than a mile away from two great access points to the lake with boat launches, walking trails, and a sand beach. We are located 13 miles from the heart of downtown.

The space
We have recently fully renovated our home and added several eclectic and modern touches! You will have access to two bedrooms, two bathrooms, fully stocked kitchen, dining room, and family room with a TV. We are always available to answer any questions or provide recommendations for your stay so please don’t hesitate to reach out!

Other things to note
Parking can be limited so please ask us if we can accommodate parking for large trailers, several vehicles or boats prior to booking. This is not an event space. If you are hosting an event, you can change your search criteria in Airbnb to find an event space or there is a community center down the road that has event space for rent at a very cheap price. 

House rules are as follows:
- Remove shoes in the house 
- No pets
- No parties 
- No additional guests outside those you booked for 
- No sleeping on the couches
- Absolutely no smoking in the house. 
- No lighting the fireplace, it is decoration only and not setup for use. 
- Treat it like your own home and if you spill things or make a mess be respectful and clean it up. 

Please note, there are also steps getting into the house without railings.
